title: Witchspace Titanoboa module
description: One section of Wexley-Yorozu's Titanoboa, built to the coupling standard (docs/design/ship-the-titanoboa.md). Units are metres; +Z is forward (towards the maw), +Y is up. The module runs from z = +length/2 to -length/2; at each coupled end the game adds a 35 m half-neck of the 140 m coupling square, so the body stops 35 m short there and must end in a flat face covering the square.

id.description: Unique kebab-case id. Must match the file name (without .json).

zone.description: Where it belongs in a line-up, prow to stern.

length.description: Metres from fore end to aft end, necks included.

description.description: One sentence on what it does, in Wexley-Yorozu's catalogue voice.

designer.description: The callsign of the commander who designed it: Wexley-Yorozu pays that commander 5,000 Cr in the game, once, when it's first fitted (docs/design/ship-the-titanoboa.md, "Paid on commission"). They must be signed in with that callsign to be paid.

inService.description: When an accepted module goes into service. From this date (UTC), a share of new Titanoboa builds carry it; the first build that does is when it's first fitted, and its designer's commission falls due. Set by a maintainer on acceptance. Core modules have none.

from.description: The date, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC), from which new builds may carry it.

replaces.description: The id of a module of the same zone whose place it takes in the builds that carry it. Leave it out to add the module to the line-up instead, at its zone's place.

share.description: The share of new builds that carry it (default 0.5).

revisions.description: Accepted improvements, oldest first. Each improver is paid 2,000 Cr, once, when the first build carrying the module after the revision's date is fitted. The designer keeps the credit.

from.description: The date, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC), the revision was accepted.

faces.description: Flat, convex polygons wound counter-clockwise from outside.
